meta.readme: Runways that are missing from the official Rata file gis/rata-official/rwy.json. Made by us, so it stays safe when Rata publishes new files. Same format as rwy.json: one LineString per runway, from threshold to threshold, [longitude, latitude]. Used only to draw closed-airfield rectangles (notam-geometry.mjs v1.00.022). Each entry says where its numbers came from.
